unifiedFailureLaw.lawName: THE RELATIONAL-INSTANTANEOUS PRINCIPLE (Why All 6 Failures Happened)
unifiedFailureLaw.statement: Every single failure across 13 labs occurred when we asked a brain or algorithm to rely on ABSOLUTE, STATIC, or PASSIVE quantities (absolute single-site voltage, static linear forward extrapolation, fixed occipital alpha, static local synchrony, passive couple sync). Every single breakthrough occurred when we switched to RELATIONAL, INSTANTANEOUS, or SCALE-FREE INVARIANTS (Δ_WK = slopeBB + 2*DFA - 1, Right-Left Frontal 1/f asymmetry, Theta wPLI phase-lag coupling, Gromov relational distance matrices, and reactive instantaneous gating).
unifiedFailureLaw.engineeringCorollary: Never build a wearable brain interface on absolute power thresholds or static multi-second linear predictors; build exclusively on self-referencing dimensionless ratios (Δ_WK, wkOverDelta, R-L asymmetry, wPLI).
